title: Chicken Teriyaki with Chewy Trio Crunch
description: A delicious Japanese-inspired dish featuring chicken teriyaki with a crunchy topping made from chewy trio.
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, and sesame oil. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
In a separate pan, cook chicken breast over medium-high heat until browned on both sides. Transfer to oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
In a separate pan, toast chewy trio over medium heat until crispy.
Slice cooked chicken into thin strips and serve with teriyaki sauce and topped with crispy chewy trio and green onions.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
